title: Check the Linux kernel version
summary: Show the version of the Linux kernel that is running right now. Use it to compare your kernel with the version a guide or a driver asks for.

aliases.text: which linux kernel do I have

steps.explain: Print the kernel release of the running system. Look for a version string such as 6.8.0-41-generic: the first numbers (6.8.0) are the kernel version, the rest is the build or distribution suffix.
steps.expect: One line with the kernel release, for example 6.8.0-41-generic.

source.title: uname manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
